objective: Display GP from existing financial inputs without IO, cache initialization or GP Activity; preserve original SI save confirmation.

rules.gp: Pure arithmetic, saved applicable order FX and confirmed source costs; immutable issued SI slices
Original business handlers only; no added GP follow-up
Original confirmation and locks retained; no independent GP event
Existing single capture retained; new Desk reuses warehouseCbm resolver

failurePolicy.confirmedBusinessSave: Never repeat, roll back, or alter a confirmed PO/stock/payment operation solely because a derived GP cache fails.
failurePolicy.unconfirmedGp: Do not display stale cache as current or missing data as zero; retain original request for controlled same-save repair.
failurePolicy.locks: Retain GP/COST/Finance locks, source-version checks and invoice immutability.
failurePolicy.legacy: Preserve verified existing PO/invoice values; no read-triggered backfill, dummy PO edit, deletion or invented source margin.

Pure document/payment/date/message/reorder produce no GP work
